MY ORDER ARRIVED AND ONE ITEM IS DAMAGED, WHAT DO I DO?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
I’m sorry your item arrived damaged.
Please inspect your order upon reception and initiate an EXCHANGE REQUEST THROUGH THE RETURN PORTAL, selecting the appropriate return reason for the damaged item. You’ll be asked to provide:
- a brief description of the damage
- an image of the item
- an image of the care tag located on the inside of the garment
After that, the team will review your request, and IF IT’S APPROVED, YOU’LL RECEIVE AN EMAIL WITH A PREPAID LABEL.
Per policy, ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and THEY CAN ONLY EXCHANGE THE SAME STYLE.
